ideas.pitch: A tamper-evident digital chain-of-custody logging system tailored for forensic evidence collection by NFSU investigators.
ideas.title: ForensicChain Evidence Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the domain expertise of National Forensic Sciences University, making it instantly relevant to the host institution's judging panel.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first security log anomaly detector that highlights malicious IP activity for forensic cyber investigations.
ideas.title: CyberSleuth Log Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the cybersecurity and investigative focus of NFSU Guwahati, scoring high on problem understanding and practical feasibility.

ideas.pitch: A voice-activated crime scene note-taking and auto-summarization tool designed for fast-paced forensic documentation.
ideas.title: SceneScribe Mobile
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features a live, working audio-to-summary demo which is fast to build and hits the presentation and demonstration judging criteria directly.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision prototype for classifying physical trace evidence categories from mobile camera uploads.
ideas.title: TraceScan AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies high-impact computer vision to a forensic use case, appealing to technical implementation and innovation metrics.

ideas.pitch: An Arduino and web dashboard setup to monitor chemical storage lab conditions and trigger real-time hazard alerts.
ideas.title: SafeLab IoT Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Practical feasibility and hardware-software integration make it stand out against purely software-based submissions.
